headline: Nearly mad over Russia and Japan
summary: At Sagamore Hill Roosevelt sees immigration official Marcus Braun and Judge William Calhoun, who stays to dinner. He vents to Whitelaw Reid about Russia's muddle, asks Alice to join Taft's goodwill trip to Japan as his representative, and names John Stevens to replace John Wallace as chief canal engineer. Bob Ferguson marries Isabella Selmes.

letters.topic: Frustration with Russia's confusion; Japan's fair demands

tr_quotes.text: Oh lord! I have been growing nearly mad in the effort to get Russia and Japan together.

Japan has a right to ask a good deal and I do not think that her demands are excessive; but Russia is so soddenly stupid and the government is such an amorphous affair that they really do not know what they want.
